findings.description: verify-module-completion and verify-no-false-green-certify are in tension when a module has all its own items PASS but open shared CLS-* class cards list it in modules[]. verify-module-completion requires complete:false ↔ N<M, verify-no-false-green-certify requires complete:false when open classes touch the module. The reconciliation requires adding a synthetic OPEN item to the module manifest to make N<M consistent. This works but is a modeling gap — the guards should natively understand cross-cutting classes without requiring a synthetic item.
findings.disposition: OPEN — fixer lane should add native shared-class awareness to verify-module-completion so that a module with all its own items PASS but open shared classes referencing it is automatically treated as incomplete, without needing a synthetic BANK-CLS-SHARED item.
